Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Perin Quoran: 30-year-old man, 186 cm (tall), exceptional bodybuilder construction with enormous but coherent human muscle mass, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: broad oval face; asymmetric brows and broad cheek planes; small upturned nose, heavy lower lip; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: black, bun-topknot-wrapped, deliberate accent: offset gathered mass. Wardrobe: quilted-outerwear, specifically lightly quilted cloth outerwear over a simple fitted layer and tapered trousers; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette rust-charcoal. Visible personal details: an extensive matte botanical tattoo language over one shoulder, torso edge, and forearm. Make body construction and habitual posture the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: meticulous daily maintenance. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a clay tea token only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
